mergedParams.userDescription: Opacity-based & Blur-based focus change. internal effects for text, video, images

output.title: Opacity & Blur Focus Effects for Text, Video, Images

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset called 'DepthOfField' that simulates camera focus changes using combined opacity and blur animations. The effect should create a cinematic depth-of-field transition where elements fade in/out while simultaneously adjusting blur levels to mimic rack focus techniques from cinematography. Accept parameters for focus duration (default 1s), blur intensity (0-20px range), opacity curves (linear vs ease-in-out), and focus direction (in/out). The effect should use generic AnimationRange arrays with synchronized opacity (0 to 1) and blur (20px to 0px for focus-in, opposite for focus-out) progressions. Include a 'hold' parameter to maintain focus state for a specified duration before reversing. Target multiple elements simultaneously with staggered timing offsets for layered depth perception.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: opacity (0-1 range), filter blur (0-20px). Structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], start: 0, duration: params.duration || 1, ranges: [{ key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'filter', val: ['blur(20px)', 'blur(10px)', 'blur(3px)', 'blur(0px)'], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }] }. Params schema: z.object({ duration: z.number().default(1), blurIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(20).default(10), direction: z.enum(['in', 'out']).default('in'), hold: z.number().optional(), stagger: z.number().default(0.1) }). Return: { effects: [...] } with _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects'.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'PulseFocus' internal effect preset that creates rhythmic attention-grabbing pulses combining opacity flickers with subtle blur breathing. Design it for highlighting key text moments or image focal points in sync with audio beats. The effect should use waveform data to drive both opacity (0.5-1 range) and blur (0-5px) oscillations reacting to bass frequencies. Include sensitivity controls for audio reactivity (0.1-1.0), pulse intensity multiplier, and base opacity floor. Add a 'breathe' mode that creates smooth sine-wave-like transitions versus a 'punch' mode for sharp, staccato emphasis. Support targeting multiple elements with phase offsets to create wave-like focus patterns across the composition.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform (audio-reactive). Configuration: { type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], effectType: 'custom', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: params.sensitivity || 0.5, threshold: 0.3, props: { opacity: { min: params.baseOpacity || 0.5, max: 1, smooth: params.breatheMode }, filter: { blur: { min: 0, max: params.blurMax || 5, unit: 'px' } } } }. Params: z.object({ sensitivity: z.number().min(0.1).max(1).default(0.5), blurMax: z.number().max(10).default(5), baseOpacity: z.number().min(0.3).max(0.9).default(0.5), breatheMode: z.boolean().default(true), phaseOffset: z.number().default(0) }). PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }.

prompts.prompt: Develop a 'SelectiveFocus' internal effect that applies variable focus levels to different targets, simulating tilt-shift or selective focus photography. Create three focus zones: sharp (no blur, full opacity), mid-focus (slight blur 3-5px, 0.8 opacity), and out-of-focus (heavy blur 10-15px, 0.4 opacity). Accept an array of targetIds mapped to focus zones, allowing precise control over which elements are in focus. Include smooth transition capabilities between focus states with customizable easing curves (spring for natural camera movement, ease-in-out for mechanical). Add a 'focusShift' parameter to animate focus changes over time, moving the sharp zone across different targets sequentially.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with multiple target groups. Structure: effects array with different configs per zone. Sharp zone: { opacity: 1, filter: 'blur(0px)' }, Mid zone: { opacity: 0.8, filter: 'blur(4px)' }, Out zone: { opacity: 0.4, filter: 'blur(12px)' }. Params: z.object({ zones: z.object({ sharp: z.array(z.string()), mid: z.array(z.string()), out: z.array(z.string()) }), transitionDuration: z.number().default(0.8), easing: z.enum(['spring', 'ease-in-out', 'linear']).default('spring'), focusShift: z.object({ enabled: z.boolean(), interval: z.number() }).optional() }). Returns array of effects, one per zone with appropriate targetIds.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'CinematicReveal' internal effect that combines directional blur with opacity to simulate camera lens aperture opening/closing. The effect should start with heavy radial blur (simulating closed aperture) and zero opacity, then gradually open to reveal sharp content. Include parameters for aperture shape (circular vs hexagonal blur kernel), opening speed with acceleration curve, and vignette darkness around edges. Add a 'focusPull' option that shifts the blur center point during the reveal, creating dynamic focus tracking. Support both opening and closing directions, with optional 'blink' mode for quick focus resets between scenes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with complex filter values. AnimationRange: [{ key: 'opacity', val: [0, 0.2, 0.6, 1], prog: [0, 0.2, 0.6, 1] }, { key: 'filter', val: ['blur(25px) brightness(0.3)', 'blur(15px) brightness(0.5)', 'blur(5px) brightness(0.8)', 'blur(0px) brightness(1)'], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }]. Params: z.object({ duration: z.number().default(1.5), apertureShape: z.enum(['circular', 'hexagonal']).default('circular'), direction: z.enum(['open', 'close']).default('open'), vignette: z.boolean().default(true), focusPull: z.object({ enabled: z.boolean(), startX: z.number(), startY: z.number(), endX: z.number(), endY: z.number() }).optional(), blinkMode: z.boolean().default(false) }). Mode: 'provider' with targetIds array.

prompts.prompt: Build an 'AudioFocusWave' internal effect that creates traveling waves of focus across multiple elements based on audio frequency analysis. Use high frequencies to control opacity waves (creating sparkle effects) and low frequencies for blur waves (creating depth pulsations). The effect should analyze the full frequency spectrum and map different ranges to different focus behaviors. Include a 'propagation' system where focus changes ripple from a center point outward with customizable wave speed and decay. Support both radial and linear wave patterns. Add 'resonance' parameter to create standing wave patterns at specific frequencies.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: waveform with frequency analysis. Multiple effects: [{ type: 'waveform', effectType: 'custom', audioProperty: 'frequency', frequencyRange: [2000, 8000], props: { opacity: { oscillate: true, min: 0.7, max: 1 } } }, { type: 'waveform', audioProperty: 'bass', props: { filter: { blur: { min: 0, max: 8, smooth: true } } } }]. Params: z.object({ waveSpeed: z.number().default(1), wavePattern: z.enum(['radial', 'linear']).default('radial'), centerPoint: z.object({ x: z.number(), y: z.number() }).optional(), decay: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.3), resonanceFreq: z.number().optional(), sensitivity: z.object({ high: z.number(), low: z.number() }).default({ high: 0.7, low: 0.5 }) }). Returns array of waveform effects with calculated delays per targetId.

prompts.prompt: Design a 'FocusLayers' internal effect preset that creates multi-layered depth using progressive opacity and blur values. Implement a parallax-style focus system where different layers have different focus characteristics - foreground elements get sharp focus with subtle edge blur, midground gets moderate blur with slight opacity reduction, and background gets heavy blur with significant opacity reduction. Include 'focusBreathing' parameter to add subtle focus hunting animation (mimicking camera autofocus). Support dynamic layer reassignment during playback, allowing elements to move between focus layers. Add chromatic aberration simulation for out-of-focus areas using color channel splits.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined (generic + computed). Layer configs: Foreground: { opacity: [0.9, 1], blur: [2, 0], prog: [0, 1] }, Midground: { opacity: [0.6, 0.75], blur: [5, 3], prog: [0, 1] }, Background: { opacity: [0.3, 0.4], blur: [12, 10], prog: [0, 1] }. Chromatic aberration via filter: 'blur(var(--blur)) drop-shadow(1px 0 0 rgba(255,0,0,0.3)) drop-shadow(-1px 0 0 rgba(0,255,0,0.3))'. Params: z.object({ layers: z.object({ foreground: z.array(z.string()), midground: z.array(z.string()), background: z.array(z.string()) }), focusBreathing: z.object({ enabled: z.boolean(), intensity: z.number(), frequency: z.number() }).optional(), chromaticAberration: z.boolean().default(false), transitionDuration: z.number().default(1) }). Returns effects array with layer-specific configurations.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'StrobeFlicker' internal effect that uses rapid opacity and blur oscillations to create attention-demanding strobe effects. Design it for dramatic text reveals or image transitions with customizable flicker patterns (regular, irregular, morse-code-like). The effect should combine opacity strobing (0 to 1) with synchronized blur pulsing (0 to 10px) to create disorienting yet controlled visual chaos. Include 'safeMode' parameter to limit strobe frequency for accessibility. Add 'decayStrobe' option where flicker intensity decreases over time, settling into focus. Support pattern presets like 'electric', 'broken-bulb', 'lightning', and custom pattern arrays.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with rapid keyframes. Pattern examples: Electric: [1,0,1,0,0,1,1,0,1], Broken: [1,1,0,1,0,0,1,0,1,1], Lightning: [0,1,1,0,0,0,1,0]. AnimationRange for each flicker: { key: 'opacity', val: pattern.map(v => v), prog: pattern.map((_, i) => i/pattern.length) }, blur synchronized. Params: z.object({ pattern: z.union([z.enum(['electric', 'broken-bulb', 'lightning']), z.array(z.number())]).default('electric'), frequency: z.number().min(1).max(30).default(10), blurIntensity: z.number().max(15).default(10), safeMode: z.boolean().default(true), decayStrobe: z.object({ enabled: z.boolean(), decayRate: z.number() }).optional(), duration: z.number().default(0.5) }). SafeMode limits frequency to max 10Hz.

prompts.prompt: Develop a 'GlitchFocus' internal effect combining digital glitch aesthetics with focus manipulation. Create RGB channel splits with varying blur levels per color channel, opacity glitches, and position offsets to simulate digital focus errors. The effect should include random or audio-triggered glitch moments where focus completely breaks before snapping back. Add parameters for glitch intensity, color channel separation distance, and corruption probability. Include 'dataMode' where glitches follow binary patterns or 'chaosMode' for pure randomization. Support both subtle (professional) and extreme (artistic) glitch levels.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: combined with computed glitch positions. RGB split via multiple effects: Red channel: { filter: 'blur(3px)', transform: 'translateX(-2px)', opacity: 0.9 }, Green: { filter: 'blur(1px)', opacity: 1 }, Blue: { filter: 'blur(2px)', transform: 'translateX(2px)', opacity: 0.9 }. Glitch triggers: Math.random() < params.corruptionProbability. Params: z.object({ intensity: z.enum(['subtle', 'moderate', 'extreme']).default('moderate'), channelSeparation: z.number().max(10).default(3), corruptionProbability: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.1), mode: z.enum(['data', 'chaos']).default('chaos'), audioTriggered: z.boolean().default(false), snapbackSpeed: z.number().default(0.1) }). Returns array with base effect plus computed glitch overlays.

prompts.prompt: Build a 'ProximityFocus' internal effect that adjusts focus based on spatial relationships between elements. Elements closer to a defined focus point get sharp rendering (no blur, full opacity) while distant elements progressively lose focus. Calculate distance-based blur values (0-20px) and opacity (0.3-1) using element positions. Include 'focusTracking' to move the focus point over time, creating dynamic focus pulls. Add 'depthOfField' parameter to control focus falloff curve (linear, exponential, gaussian). Support multiple focus points with weighted influence. Include 'bokeh' mode that adds hexagonal blur shapes to out-of-focus areas.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with computed values based on position. Distance calculation: Math.sqrt((targetX - focusX)² + (targetY - focusY)²). Blur mapping: blur = Math.min(20, distance * params.falloffRate). Opacity mapping: opacity = Math.max(0.3, 1 - (distance * params.opacityFalloff)). Params: z.object({ focusPoint: z.object({ x: z.number(), y: z.number() }), falloffRate: z.number().default(0.05), opacityFalloff: z.number().default(0.002), depthCurve: z.enum(['linear', 'exponential', 'gaussian']).default('exponential'), focusTracking: z.object({ enabled: z.boolean(), path: z.array(z.object({ x: z.number(), y: z.number(), duration: z.number() })) }).optional(), bokehMode: z.boolean().default(false), maxBlur: z.number().default(20) }). Returns individual effects per targetId with computed values.

prompts.prompt: Create a 'TextReadabilityFocus' internal effect specifically optimized for text elements, using subtle opacity and text-shadow blur instead of filter blur to maintain readability. The effect should enhance text focus using opacity (0.5-1 range) combined with text-shadow spreading (0-5px blur radius) and letter-spacing adjustments (condensed when blurred, normal when focused). Include 'typewriter' mode where focus follows text progression word-by-word. Add 'highlighter' parameter that adds background glow to focused text. Support both fade-in and fade-out directions with customizable timing curves optimized for reading speed.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: generic with text-specific properties. AnimationRange: [{ key: 'opacity', val: [0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'textShadow', val: ['0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)', '0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)', '0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)', 'none'], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }, { key: 'letterSpacing', val: ['-0.05em', '-0.02em', '0', '0.02em'], prog: [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1] }]. Params: z.object({ direction: z.enum(['in', 'out']).default('in'), duration: z.number().default(0.6), typewriterMode: z.object({ enabled: z.boolean(), wordsPerSecond: z.number() }).optional(), highlighter: z.object({ enabled: z.boolean(), color: z.string(), intensity: z.number() }).optional(), readingOptimized: z.boolean().default(true) }). Mode: 'provider' with text element targetIds.
